title: Grok Build pricing, limits and changes · BurnRate

facts.fact: The Free plan costs $0 per month and offers limited Grok Build access, per the BurnRate table, which cites cursor.com/pricing.
The Plus plan costs $8 per month, or $6.67 per month on annual billing, and its limits are a shared weekly pool with Grok and Cursor (base).
facts.quote: | Plus | $8 ($6.67 annual) | Shared weekly pool with Grok and Cursor (base) |

facts.fact: The Plus plan costs $6.67 per month on annual billing.
facts.quote: | Plus | $8 ($6.67 annual) | Shared weekly pool with Grok and Cursor (base) |

facts.fact: The Premium plan costs $30 per month, or $25 per month on annual billing, and provides 4x Plus limits.
The Super plan costs $100 per month, or $84 per month on annual billing, and provides 15x Plus limits.
The Ultra plan costs $200 per month, or $167 per month on annual billing, and provides 50x Plus limits.
The grok-build-0.1 API model is priced at $1 per million input tokens.
facts.quote: | API key | unknown | grok-build-0.1: $1/M input, $0.20/M cached, $2/M output |

facts.fact: The grok-build-0.1 API model is priced at $0.20 per million cached tokens.
facts.quote: | API key | unknown | grok-build-0.1: $1/M input, $0.20/M cached, $2/M output |

facts.fact: The grok-build-0.1 API model is priced at $2 per million output tokens.
facts.quote: | API key | unknown | grok-build-0.1: $1/M input, $0.20/M cached, $2/M output |

facts.fact: Per a third-party benchmark source (AA Coding Agent Index v1.5, via aicharts.io, retrieved 2026-10-05), the cost per benchmark task for Grok 4.7 (xhigh) is $8.82.
facts.quote: Cost per benchmark task: **$8.82** (Grok 4.7 (xhigh), AA Coding Agent Index v1.5, [source](https://aicharts.io/coding), retrieved 2026-10-05).

facts.fact: On 2026-10-12, Grok Build was bundled into The X Subscription, with a weekly usage pool shared with Grok and Cursor, per the BurnRate changelog citing x.ai.
facts.quote: Grok Build bundled into The X Subscription (Plus $8 / Premium $30 / Super $100 / Ultra $200) with a weekly usage pool shared with Grok and Cursor.

facts.fact: BurnRate notes that the Grok Build launch date is not verified, and that the X Subscription date of Oct 12 is taken from standardcompute, a third-party source.
facts.quote: Grok Build launch date not verified. X Subscription date (Oct 12) taken from standardcompute.
